<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Track from './Track.vue';

const SECOND = 36; // pixels per second
const SECONDS = 12;
const TRACKS = ['video', 'audio'];

const clips = ref([
  { id: 'intro', name: 'Intro', track: 'video', start: 0, length: 3, hue: 205 },
  { id: 'scene', name: 'Scene 1', track: 'video', start: 4, length: 5, hue: 265 },
  { id: 'music', name: 'Music', track: 'audio', start: 1, length: 7, hue: 150 },
  { id: 'voice', name: 'Voice', track: 'audio', start: 9, length: 2.5, hue: 30 },
]);
const locked = ref(true);

// A clip lands where it was dropped, on the track it was dropped on, to a quarter second.
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragEnd({ active, over, position }) {
    const clip = clips.value.find((item) => item.id === active.id);
    if (!clip || !over || !position) return;
    clip.track = String(over.id);
    clip.start = Math.max(0, Math.round((position.x / SECOND) * 4) / 4);
  },
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, restrictToParent, useDnDMonitor, type Modifier } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import SlideBox from './SlideBox.vue';

const boxes = ref([
  { id: 'title', kind: 'title', x: 32, y: 28, width: 220, height: 44 },
  { id: 'image', kind: 'image', x: 300, y: 28, width: 180, height: 124 },
  { id: 'text', kind: 'text', x: 32, y: 96, width: 220, height: 56 },
  { id: 'button', kind: 'button', x: 32, y: 184, width: 104, height: 36 },
]);

const slide = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('slide');
const PULL = 8;

/** The lines a box lines up with: the other boxes' edges and centers, and the slide's. */
const lines = (id: string, axis: 'x' | 'y') => {
  const size = axis === 'x' ? 'width' : 'height';
  const edge = slide.value?.[axis === 'x' ? 'clientWidth' : 'clientHeight'] ?? 0;
  return [
    0,
    edge / 2,
    edge,
    ...boxes.value.filter((box) => box.id !== id).flatMap((box) => [box[axis], box[axis] + box[size] / 2, box[axis] + box[size]]),
  ];
};

/** How far to move `start`..`start + length` so its edge or center sits on a line within PULL px. */
const pull = (start: number, length: number, targets: number[]) => {
  let best = 0;
  for (const point of [start, start + length / 2, start + length]) {
    for (const line of targets) {
      const gap = line - point;
      if (Math.abs(gap) <= PULL && (!best || Math.abs(gap) < Math.abs(best))) best = gap;
    }
  }
  return best;
};

/**
 * A modifier of our own: it gets the offset so far and the overlay's rect, and returns a
 * new offset. Near a line, the box jumps onto it.
 */
const magnet: Modifier = ({ transform, overlayRect, containerRect, active }) => {
  if (!containerRect) return transform;
  const id = String(active.id);
  const left = overlayRect.left - containerRect.left;
  const top = overlayRect.top - containerRect.top;
  return {
    x: transform.x + pull(left, overlayRect.width, lines(id, 'x')),
    y: transform.y + pull(top, overlayRect.height, lines(id, 'y')),
  };
};
// In order: the magnet pulls, then the slide's edges hold.
const modifiers = [magnet, restrictToParent];

// The guides: the lines the box sits on exactly, after the modifiers (`delta`).
const guides = ref<{ x: number[]; y: number[] }>({ x: [], y: [] });
const on = (start: number, length: number, targets: number[]) =>
  targets.filter((line) => [start, start + length / 2, start + length].some((point) => Math.abs(point - line) < 0.5));

makeDroppable(slide, { id: 'slide' });
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragMove({ active, delta }) {
    const box = boxes.value.find((item) => item.id === active.id);
    if (!box) return;
    guides.value = {
      x: on(box.x + delta.x, box.width, lines(box.id, 'x')),
      y: on(box.y + delta.y, box.height, lines(box.id, 'y')),
    };
  },
  onDragEnd({ active, over, position }) {
    guides.value = { x: [], y: [] };
    const box = boxes.value.find((item) => item.id === active.id);
    if (!box || over?.id !== 'slide' || !position) return;
    box.x = Math.round(position.x);
    box.y = Math.round(position.y);
  },
  onDragCancel: () => (guides.value = { x: [], y: [] }),
});
</script>

<template>
  <!-- On a narrow screen, the slide scrolls sideways. -->
  <div class="scroll">
    <div ref="slide" class="slide">
      <span v-for="x in guides.x" :key="`x${x}`" class="guide vertical" :style="{ left: `${x}px` }" />
      <span v-for="y in guides.y" :key="`y${y}`" class="guide horizontal" :style="{ top: `${y}px` }" />
      <SlideBox v-for="box in boxes" :key="box.id" :box="box" :modifiers="modifiers" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

const place = (area: string, id: Key, at: Coordinates) => {
  const sticker = stickers.value.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!sticker) return;
  sticker.area = area;
  sticker.x = Math.round(at.x);
  sticker.y = Math.round(at.y);
};
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider>
    <div class="studio">
      <DragArea
        id="sketch"
        title="Sketch"
        rules="no rules"
        :stickers="stickers.filter((sticker) => sticker.area === 'sketch')"
        @place="place"
      />
      <DragArea
        id="layout"
        title="Layout"
        rules="snapToGrid(24) · restrictToArea"
        strict
        :stickers="stickers.filter((sticker) => sticker.area === 'layout')"
        @place="place"
      />
    </div>
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<style scoped>
.studio {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDragArea, makeDroppable, snapToGrid, type Coordinates, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Sticker from './Sticker.vue';

type StickerData = { id: string; text: string; color: string; x: number; y: number };
const props = defineProps<{ id: string; title: string; rules: string; strict?: boolean; stickers: StickerData[] }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ place: [area: string, id: Key, at: Coordinates] }>();

const area = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('area');
// Rules for the drags that start in here, wherever they go. The strict area snaps its
// stickers to a grid and keeps them inside; the other one lets them go anywhere.
const { isDragging } = makeDragArea(area, {
  modifiers: () => (props.strict ? [snapToGrid(24)] : []),
  restrictToArea: () => props.strict,
});

// Both areas take drops: a sticker lands where it was let go.
const { isOver } = makeDroppable(area, {
  id: props.id,
  onDrop: ({ active, position }) => position && emit('place', props.id, active.id, position),
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="panel">
    <h3>
      {{ title }}
      <code>{{ rules }}</code>
    </h3>
    <div ref="area" class="area" :class="{ strict, busy: isDragging, over: isOver }">
      <Sticker v-for="sticker in stickers" :key="sticker.id" :sticker="sticker" />
    </div>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDraggable } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ sticker: { id: string; text: string; color: string; x: number; y: number } }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// No rules of its own: the area it is in decides.
const { isDragging } = makeDraggable(el, { id: () => props.sticker.id });
</script>

<template>
  <div
    ref="el"
    class="sticker"
    :class="{ dragging: isDragging }"
    :style="{ left: `${sticker.x}px`, top: `${sticker.y}px`, '--color': sticker.color }"

    {{ sticker.text }}
